prompts.cast: Use case: stylized-concept. Supporting identity and costume reference: attached Diao Chan sheet. Create a NEW SIX-panel attack animation keypose sheet of EXACTLY the same adult woman, identical smooth black hair, gold flower/phoenix hair ornaments, plum-crimson silk embroidered split dress, closed-toe gold-trimmed shoes and two red/gold folding fans. Six full body figures, THREE columns TWO rows, clean large transparent gutters, all face to RIGHT 3/4 view, no text, effects or scenery. Maintain anatomical two arms/two hands/two legs/two shoes in every pose; distinct wrists and fingers, do not hide a hand behind a fan. First row sequence: 1 lift first open fan beside face, other fan at hip, balanced two feet; 2 coil torso with both fans raised apart, one high overhead and second in front of chest, two feet visible; 3 sweeping dance step, rightward leading fan at shoulder height, trailing fan extended to left, ribbons sweep gracefully. Second row sequence: 4 powerful decisive forward lunge, leading arm extended to RIGHT slightly upward with open fan, other arm bent with second fan clearly beside shoulder, both shoes in natural ground perspective; 5 gentle follow through, leading fan drawn diagonally down, trailing fan lifted, weight returning to rear leg; 6 return to relaxed stance holding two folded fans at waist, both hands distinct. Same polished painterly rendering as reference, no puffy hair, no additional ornaments, no mismatched costumes. Exact same relative character scale across all six panels. Complete body with padding in every cell. Real transparent alpha background.
